en-US.name: My Train Schedule
en-US.summary: Departures and arrivals for the next hour or a time you choose. Currently supports only Poland.
en-US.description:
Reads departures or arrivals from the stations you pick in the Alexa app. The skill currently supports only Poland, with other countries possible later. The next hour includes live delays when the realtime feed is fresh. You can name a time, such as 8 am, and hear that hour in Europe/Warsaw.

You choose stations on a search page during account linking. You do not say the station names. Say "Alexa, open my train schedule" after linking, or ask for departures or arrivals.

Timetable data: PKP Polskie Linie Kolejowe S.A. GTFS feed assembled by Mikołaj Kuranowski (https://mkuran.pl/gtfs/). Live updates from the same publisher.
examplePhrases: Alexa, ask my train schedule for arrivals
Alexa, ask my train schedule for departures at 8 am
